text:
alice: seeing apac-edge1 dedicated-gpu hosts with 20-40% tail latency bump for tenant-823. network counters show VF resets after the kernel update.

bob: what's the timeline? started after last night deploy?

alice: yep rolled 03:12 UTC. spike started ~03:30. metric: p50 ok, p95/p99 up ~30-120ms

carlos: grabbing ethtool/stats now

carlos: ```
# iperf3 -c 10.0.5.12 -t 10
[ ID] Interval           Transfer     Bandwidth
[  4]   0.00-10.00  sec  4.56 GBytes  3.92 Gbits/sec
```

carlos: ```
# ethtool -S ensf0
vf_reset: 78
vf_err: 23
tx_dropped: 1024
rx_no_buf: 47
```

dana: vf_reset is bad. likely SR-IOV VF driver mismatch with mlx5 5.7.12 -> 5.9.3 kernel combo

erin: ops-bot triggered NETWORK_ALERT for vf_reset surge in apac-edge1

ops-bot: NETWORK_ALERT: apac-edge1 host-78 vf_reset rate=7/min, hosts_affected=6, severity=high

frank: can we move tenant-823 off shared vf hosts to a non-SR-IOV dedicated pool? cost hit but quick fix

alice: yes that's the short-term plan. requesting dedicated carveout, 2x nodes for 24h

carlos: command to tag hosts to avoid SR-IOV: `redwoodctl host tag set host-78 no-sriov=true`

dana: or router-level throttle: set egress qdisc for tenant-823 to 250Mbps

dana: `tc qdisc replace dev ensf0 root tbf rate 250mbit burst 32k latency 400ms`

erin: which is faster? carveout or qdisc?

alice: qdisc less invasive, but carveout ensures tail latency. recommend qdisc now + carveout next maintenance window

gwyn: firmware rollback candidate: mlx5 fw 21.30 -> 20.14 showed stable in canary last month. need vendor sign-off

frank: cost note: moving to dedicated non-sriov pooled GPUs ~ +$420/day for 2 nodes, will billback to tenant. raise with billing

carlos: patch suggestion: sysctl net.core.rps_sock_flow_entries=32768 and enable scatter-gather offload for VF as temp mitigation

carlos: ```bash
sudo sysctl -w net.core.rps_sock_flow_entries=32768
sudo ethtool -K ensf0 rxvlan off
```

dana: I'll start qdisc throttle on host-78/host-83/host-91 now, and open a carveout ticket

alice: assign @dana and @carlos to the carveout and fw-rollback runbook. ETA 45m for throttle rollout

ops-bot: ticket created #INFRA-3245 Carveout tenant-823 -> dedicated-nonsriov (assignee:dana,carlos)

erin: monitoring dashboards: add p99_kv_latency and vf_reset counter to the apac-edge1 page

gwyn: if rollback is needed, schedule canary on apac-edge1-rack-2 with 1 host, then expand

frank: note to billing: capture charge id when carveout completes

alice: ok plan = (1) qdisc throttle immediate (2) carveout dedicated nodes for 24h (3) canary fw rollback if sensible (4) long-term: avoid SR-IOV for noisy tenants or force NIC-driver pinning

bob: thanks team. keep updates here, escalate if carveout doesn't restore p99 within 1 hour :thumbsup:

alice: will update in ~10m after throttle

carlos: throttle applied to 3 hosts. early signs p99 down ~12ms

alice: great, continuing to monitor :eyes:
